title: Amazon launches its first smart warehouse in Shenzhen, aiming to cut local merchant storage costs by up to 45% as competition with Shein and Temu intensifies (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)
summary: Iris Deng / South China Morning Post: Amazon launches its first smart warehouse in Shenzhen, aiming to cut local merchant storage costs by up to 45% as competition with Shein and Temu intensifies — Amazon expands China push with smart warehouse model, aiming to retain sellers amid rising competition from Temu and Shein
